lines: 全职法师最新章节_关于奏第1页_全职法师乱_热点小说网
作为全书的女主角，多了一个学生，这个学生性别为男，仅此而已。
就这么简单的一件事情，却被一个人恶意带节奏。
不得了啦，自己心目中的女主角被玷污啦，被践踏啦，女主方圆一万公里内怎么可以有除主角以外的男性！！
我对此人的脑回路震惊之余也只剩下震惊！
首先，穆宁雪是一位独立的女性角色，如果无法接受她身边出现任何一个生物性别为男的，那麻烦大家先把穆白这个角色给抹掉，他还是穆宁雪的堂哥，关系更亲。
其次，穆宁雪的导师松鹤也是男的，他也不应该活到现在。
再以这位偏激书友的思路，穆宁雪的父亲都不应该是男性，犯了天条，我神圣的女神怎么可以有一个爸爸，五十多岁的中年男人啊，天啦鲁啦~
自己内心那么的肮脏，然后强行给我们的女主角扣上一个又一个恶心的帽子，你自己喜欢，你自己戴，别影响其他内心健康三观正常的书友！
网络不是不法之地，但凡一点点风吹草动就被人大肆做文章，群内鼓动，恶意剪辑，恶意泼污水。
也请大家警惕“某些群体”见不得网络小说的繁荣，见不得我们自己国内ip打向全世界，警惕某些群体找准机会一定要把国内诸多能向海外输出本土文化的作品给活活踩死……
我相信绝大多数书友都是能够明辨是非，也期望那些还不知道发生了什么事情的书友不要被那些恶意人士扇动。
理智阅读，理智评判，欢迎广大网友明辨引起节奏的正文内容，大家立刻会知道带节奏的人有多离谱……
也请没那个耐心看的朋友不要听信什么女主角怎么怎么了的谣言，那是他自己脑子臆想的。
关于这位恶意人士对我网络开盒问题——请你认真阅读以下文字！
这位开盒我的朋友，你犯了一个致命的失误。
我在互联网上的所有信息都是做了分类，当你贴出我张照片的那一刻，我就知道这张照片来源于哪里，因为这张照片仅用于一项用途。
被开盒的电话号码也仅对一个圈子公开的电话号码。
所以这位开盒人士的身份对网警而言已等于瓮中之鳖。
因为你这种违法行为的判罚标准，由事件影响的大小决定。
巧了，你可能还差一点点数据和流量。
但你再执迷不悟，让事情继续恶意发酵下去，那恭喜你，当地警局会联系你的。
不管怎么样，眼下理智书友还是占了多数，你们是真的懒得理这种人，我也本不想理会这种恶意污名。
网络小说写这么多年，经历太多次这种情况了，我其实都习惯了……
但作为当事人，看到那么多忠实书友为我说话，我觉得我需要站出来替这些广大维护我的读者们讨回一个公道！

Versatile Mage Latest Chapter_About Page 1_Versatile Mage Chaos_Hot Novel Network
As the heroine of the book, there is one more student. This student is male, that's all.
It was such a simple thing, but it was maliciously controlled by one person.
It’s incredible. The heroine in my mind has been defiled and trampled on. How can there be a man other than the heroine within a radius of 10,000 kilometers! !
I was shocked and only shocked by this person's brain circuit!
First of all, Mu Ningxue is an independent female character. If you cannot accept the presence of any biological male around her, then please delete the character of Mu Bai first. He is also Mu Ningxue's cousin and has a closer relationship with her.
Secondly, Mu Ningxue's mentor Song He is also a man, and he should not be alive until now.
According to this extreme book friend's thinking, Mu Ningxue's father should not be a man. It violates the law of heaven. How can my sacred goddess have a father, a middle-aged man in his fifties? Oh my god~
You are so dirty inside, and then you forcefully put one disgusting label on our heroine. You like it, wear it yourself, and don't affect other book friends who have a healthy inner mind and normal outlook!
The Internet is not a place for lawlessness. Any slightest disturbance will be made a big fuss about, instigated in the group, maliciously edited, and maliciously slandered.
Please also be wary of "certain groups" who do not want to see the prosperity of online novels, and do not want our domestic IP to be broadcast to the world. Be wary of certain groups who will find the right opportunity to trample to death many domestic works that can export local culture overseas...
I believe that the vast majority of book lovers can distinguish right from wrong, and I also hope that those who do not know what is going on will not be instigated by those malicious people.
Read rationally and judge rationally. Netizens are welcome to discern clearly the content of the text that causes the rhythm. Everyone will immediately know how outrageous the person who sets the rhythm is...
Please also ask friends who don’t have the patience to watch it not to believe the rumors about what happened to the heroine. Those are just his own imagination.
Regarding the problem of this malicious person opening the box on my network - please read the following text carefully!
My friend who opened the box, you made a fatal mistake.
All the information I have on the internet is categorized, and the moment you post a photo of me, I know where it comes from because it is only used for one purpose.
The phone number that was opened is also a phone number that is only public to one circle.
Therefore, the identity of the person who opened the box is like a turtle in the urn to the Internet police.
Because the standard of punishment for your illegal behavior is determined by the impact of the incident.
Fortunately, you may still be a little short of data and traffic.
But if you persist in your stubbornness and let the matter continue to ferment maliciously, congratulations, the local police station will contact you.
No matter what, the majority of rational book friends are still in the majority now. You really don’t want to deal with such people, and I don’t want to deal with this malicious stigma.
After writing online novels for so many years, I have experienced this situation so many times that I am actually used to it...
But as a person involved, seeing so many loyal book friends speaking for me, I feel that I need to stand up and seek justice for these readers who defend me!
